open_decision: Whether an unidentified owner whose lock age is exactly equal to stale_after is recovered (age >= stale_after) or kept (age > stale_after).
input: {pidKnown := false, alive := false, reused := false, age := some 5, staleAfter := 5}
result_a: true (remove the lock file): design that recovers when age >= staleAfter, as ref does
result_b: false (keep the lock file): design that recovers only when age > staleAfter
reason: The laws force true for age > staleAfter and false for age < staleAfter, but no law covers age = staleAfter with an unknown pid. All other cases are fixed by the laws, so two rules that differ only at this boundary both pass every law.
